anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics indicate no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform with active strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially enhance AI module to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Assess and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are effectively engaging in trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability and impact trading operations.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the AI module to ensure it is operational and correctly configured to perform learning cycles and generate opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review the trading strategies and system configuration to ensure they are correctly set up to execute trades.
recommendations.rationale: No active trades or profit/loss may indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.
